statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Participate in talking and listening in every area of learning

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Listen to, respond to and explore stories, poems, songs, drama, and media texts through the use of traditional and digital resources and recreate parts of them in a range of expressive activities

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Listen to, interpret and retell, with some supporting detail, a range of oral and written texts

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Tell their own stories based on personal experiences and imagination

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Listen to and respond to guidance and instructions

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Take turns at talking and listening in group and paired activities

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Take part in a range of drama activities to support activity based learning across the curriculum

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Express thoughts, feelings and opinions in response to personal experiences, imaginary situations, literature, media and curricular topics and activities

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Present ideas and information with some structure and sequence

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Think about what they say and how they say it

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Speak audibly and clearly, using appropriate quality of speech and voice

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Devise and ask questions to find information in social situations and across the curriculum

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Read aloud from a variety of sources, including their own work, inflecting appropriately to emphasise meaning

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Recognise and talk about features of spoken language, showing phonological awareness.

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Participate in modelled, shared, paired and guided reading activities

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Read, and be read to from a wide selection of poetry and prose

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Read with some independence for enjoyment and information

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Read, explore, understand and make use of a range of traditional and digital texts

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Re-tell, re-read and act out a range of texts, representing ideas through drama, pictures, diagrams and ICT

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Begin to locate, select and use texts for specific purposes

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Research and manage information relevant to specific purposes, using traditional and digital sources, and present their findings in a variety of ways

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Use a range of comprehension skills, both oral and written, to interpret and discuss texts

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Explore and begin to understand how texts are structured in a range of genres

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Explore and interpret a range of visual texts

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Express opinions and give reasons based on what they have read

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Begin to use evidence from text to support their views

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Read and share their own books of stories and poems including the use of digital resources

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Build up a sight vocabulary

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Use a range of strategies to identify unfamiliar words

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Talk with the teacher about ways in which language is written down, identifying phrases, words, patterns or letters and other features of written language

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Recognise and notice how words are constructed and spelt.

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Participate in modelled, shared, guided and independent writing, including composing on-screen

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Understand and use a range of vocabulary by investigating and experimenting with language

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Talk about and plan what they are going to write

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Begin to check their work in relation to specific criteria

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Write without prompting, making their own decisions about form and content

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Write for a variety of purposes and audiences

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Express thoughts, feelings and opinions in imaginative and factual writing

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Organise, structure and present ideas and information using traditional and digital means

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Understand some of the differences between spoken and written language

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Use a variety of skills to spell words in their writing

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Spell correctly a range of familiar, important and regularly occurring words

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Develop increasing competence in the use of grammar and punctuation

statements.subject: Language and Literacy
statements.text: Use a legible style of handwriting.

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Processes in Mathematics: Making and Monitoring Decisions
statements.text: Select the materials and mathematics appropriate for a task

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Processes in Mathematics: Making and Monitoring Decisions
statements.text: Develop different approaches to problem solving

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Processes in Mathematics: Making and Monitoring Decisions
statements.text: Begin to organise their own work and work systematically.

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Understand mathematical language and be able to use it to talk about their work

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Represent work in a clear and organised way, using symbols where appropriate.

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Recognise simple patterns and relationships and make predictions

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Ask and respond to open-ended questions

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Explain their way of working

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Know ways to check their own work.

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Number: Understanding Number and Number Notation
statements.text: Count, read, write and order whole numbers, initially to 10, progressing to at least 1,000

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Number: Understanding Number and Number Notation
statements.text: Understand the empty set and the conservation of number

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Number: Understanding Number and Number Notation
statements.text: Understand that the place of the digit indicates its value

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Number: Understanding Number and Number Notation
statements.text: Make a sensible estimate of a small number of objects and begin to approximate to the nearest 10 or 100

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Number: Understanding Number and Number Notation
statements.text: Recognise and use simple everyday fractions.

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Number: Patterns, Relationships and Sequences in Number
statements.text: Copy, continue and devise repeating patterns

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Number: Patterns, Relationships and Sequences in Number
statements.text: Explore patterns in number tables

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Number: Patterns, Relationships and Sequences in Number
statements.text: Understand the commutative property of addition and the relationship between addition and subtraction

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Number: Patterns, Relationships and Sequences in Number
statements.text: Understand the use of a symbol to stand for an unknown number

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Number: Patterns, Relationships and Sequences in Number
statements.text: Understand and use simple function machines.

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Understand the operations of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division (without remainders) and use them to solve problems

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Know addition and subtraction facts to 20 and the majority of multiplication facts up to 10 x 10

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Develop strategies for adding and subtracting mentally up to the addition of two two-digit numbers within 100.

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Recognise coins and use them in simple contexts

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Add and subtract money up to £10, use the conventional way of recording money, and use these skills to solve problems

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Talk about the value of money and ways in which it could be spent, saved and kept safe

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Talk about what money is and alternatives for paying

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Decide how to spend money.

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Understand and use the language associated with length, ‘weight’, capacity, area and time

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Use non-standard units to measure and recognise the need for standard units

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Know and use the most commonly used units to measure in purposeful contexts

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Make estimates using arbitrary and standard units

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Choose and use simple measuring instruments, reading and interpreting them with reasonable accuracy

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Sequence everyday events; know the days of the week, months of the year and seasons; explore calendar patterns

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Recognise times on the analogue clock and digital displays

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.text: Understand the conservation of measures.

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Shape and Space: Exploration of Shape
statements.text: Sort 2-D and 3-D shapes in different ways

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Shape and Space: Exploration of Shape
statements.text: Make constructions, pictures and patterns using 2-D and 3-D shapes

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Shape and Space: Exploration of Shape
statements.text: Name and describe 2-D and 3-D shapes; recognise reflective symmetry

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Shape and Space: Exploration of Shape
statements.text: Explore simple tessellation through practical activities.

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Shape and Space: Position, Movement and Direction
statements.text: Use prepositions to state position

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Shape and Space: Position, Movement and Direction
statements.text: Understand angle as a measure of turn; understand and give instructions for turning through right angles

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Shape and Space: Position, Movement and Direction
statements.text: Recognise right-angled corners in 2-D and 3-D shapes

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Shape and Space: Position, Movement and Direction
statements.text: Know the four points of the compass

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Shape and Space: Position, Movement and Direction
statements.text: Use programmable devices to explore movement and direction.

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Handling Data: Collecting, Representing and Interpreting Data
statements.text: Sort and classify objects for one or two criteria and represent results using Venn, Carroll and Tree diagrams

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Handling Data: Collecting, Representing and Interpreting Data
statements.text: Collect data, record and present it using real objects, drawings, tables, mapping diagrams, simple graphs and ICT software

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Handling Data: Collecting, Representing and Interpreting Data
statements.text: Discuss and interpret the data

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Handling Data: Collecting, Representing and Interpreting Data
statements.text: Extract information from a range of charts, diagrams and tables

statements.subject: Mathematics and Numeracy
statements.strand: Handling Data: Collecting, Representing and Interpreting Data
statements.text: Enter and access information using a database.

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Investigate and respond to direct sensory experience; including visual, verbal, spatial and tactile dimensions, memory and imagination

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Look at and talk about resource material to stimulate their own ideas

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Enjoy and appreciate the work of artists and designers and craftworkers from their own and other cultures; use what has been viewed as a starting point for their own work

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Explore the visual elements of colour, tone, line, shape, form, space, texture and pattern to express ideas

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Talk about their own and others’ work and how it was made, use observations to identify difficulties and suggest modifications

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Experiment with a range of media, materials, tools and processes such as: drawing, painting, printmaking, malleable materials, textiles and three-dimensional construction.

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Work creatively with sound by investigating, experimenting, selecting and combining sounds to express feelings, ideas, mood and atmosphere

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Sing and perform with simple instruments to develop vocal and manipulative control

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Listen and respond to their own and others’ music-making, thinking and talking about sounds, effects and musical features in music that they create, perform or listen to.

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Develop their understanding of the world by engaging in a range of creative and imaginative role play situations by creating invented situations on their own and with others, and responding in role to the dramatic play of others and to the teacher in role

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Explore a range of cultural and human issues in a safe environment by participating in dramatic activity and sharing ideas with others

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Develop a range of drama strategies including freeze frame, tableau and hot seating

statements.subject: The Arts
statements.text: Develop dramatic skills appropriate to audience, context, purpose and task by using simple props to suggest character, and by using symbols and images to develop action and make meaning.

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: ‘Me’ in the world

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: How plants and animals rely on each other within the natural world

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: Interdependence of people and the environment

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: The effect of people on the natural environment over time

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: Interdependence of people, plants, animals and place.

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: How place influences plant and animal life

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: Ways in which living things depend on and adapt to their environment

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: Features of the immediate world and comparisons between places

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: Change over time in local places

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: Positive and negative effects of people on places.

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: Sources of energy in the world

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: How and why people and animals move

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: Changes in movement and energy over time.

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: Ways in which change occurs in the natural world

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: How people and places have changed over time

statements.subject: The World Around Us
statements.text: Positive change and how we have a responsibility to make an active contribution.

statements.subject: Personal Development and Mutual Understanding
statements.text: Their self esteem and self confidence

statements.subject: Personal Development and Mutual Understanding
statements.text: Their own and others’ feelings and emotions and how their actions affect others

statements.subject: Personal Development and Mutual Understanding
statements.text: Positive attitudes to learning and achievement

statements.subject: Personal Development and Mutual Understanding
statements.text: Strategies and skills for keeping themselves healthy and safe.

statements.subject: Personal Development and Mutual Understanding
statements.strand: Mutual Understanding in the Local and Wider Community
statements.text: Initiating and developing mutually satisfying relationships

statements.subject: Personal Development and Mutual Understanding
statements.strand: Mutual Understanding in the Local and Wider Community
statements.text: Responsibility and respect, honesty and fairness

statements.subject: Personal Development and Mutual Understanding
statements.strand: Mutual Understanding in the Local and Wider Community
statements.text: Constructive approaches to conflict

statements.subject: Personal Development and Mutual Understanding
statements.strand: Mutual Understanding in the Local and Wider Community
statements.text: Similarities and differences between people

statements.subject: Personal Development and Mutual Understanding
statements.strand: Mutual Understanding in the Local and Wider Community
statements.text: Developing themselves as members of a community.

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Participate in fun activities and physical challenges enabling them to begin to learn, understand and develop the core skills of running, jumping and throwing individually and in a co-operative context, using a variety of equipment

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Practise simple running techniques in a variety of fun activities

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Practise jumping and throwing activities, initially from a stationary position progressing to a controlled run-up

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Measure performance in simple athletic activities.

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Use different parts of the body to explore personal and general space and to move using simple actions

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Listen to, and move in response to, different stimuli and accompaniments

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Move in a controlled manner, at different speeds and in different directions, using different levels in space, (high, low), and different strengths (heavy, light)

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Perform simple steps and movements to given rhythms and musical phrases

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Create, practise, remember and perform simple movement sequences

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Develop their movements progressively individually and in pairs.

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Practise and develop the skills of handling, hitting and kicking through a range of activities and using a variety of equipment

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Develop the skills relevant to games, including running, stopping, jumping and skipping

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Make use of space to outwit an opponent

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Take part in simple games involving individual and co-operative play.

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Explore a range of movement skills, including travelling, jumping and landing, rolling, climbing, transferring weight, balancing

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Explore, practise and improve body management skills

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Form simple sequences by linking movements

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Progress from working individually to working in pairs

statements.subject: Physical Education
statements.text: Evaluate their movements and those of others.
